name: Revenue dashboard card
oneLiner: a payments dashboard card tilts in on a warm lit desk, the revenue number ticks up while a sparkline draws itself to a glowing tip, three recent payments slide in with their amounts and a growth pill stamps down beside the number
say: when the speaker says what it made or how fast it is growing ('we did 48k this month', 'the money started coming in'): cut in on the number, the pill stamps as they say how much it grew
